visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: neutral; striped tables use alternating row tint and a dark head row unless no-header is set
visualCharacteristics.layout: Semantic <table> filling the content width inside a horizontally scrollable wrapper on mobile; rows stack top to bottom, cells left-aligned, top-aligned. Two-column key/value tables (e.g. a CV: year | role) keep a narrow first column on desktop

contentPattern.structure: each block row = one table row; each cell = one table cell (inline formatting such as bold, line breaks and links is preserved; empty cells are kept). The first row becomes the table head unless the 'no header' option is set
